1.consolidated_definition: Expresión mediante la que una persona pretende desentenderse de una situación porque no desea vínculo con ella o porque no le incumbe. Quienes venimos de pueblo chiquito conocemos de primera mano ciertas frases. “De eso no se habla”; “todo el mundo lo sabe”; “es mejor hacerse de la vista gorda”; “allá Marta con sus pollos” … Todas invitando al silencio y a la aceptación de una impunidad normalizada. (El Nuevo Día, 26-08-19)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Expression used by a person to disengage from a situation because they do not wish to be associated with it or because it is none of their concern. Those who come from small towns are familiar with certain phrases, such as "That's not something we talk about"; "everyone already knows"; "it's better to turn a blind eye"; "Marta and her chickens" ... All of which invite silence and acceptance of normalized impunity.
